questions.stem: A company must back up every Amazon EBS volume and Amazon RDS database that has the tag backup=daily, once per day, and keep a copy of each backup in a second AWS Region. Teams create new tagged resources every week, and the operations team does not want to update the configuration when resources are added. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

choices.text: Create an AWS Backup plan with a daily rule that copies to the second Region, and assign resources by the tag backup=daily.
Create an AWS Backup plan with a daily rule that copies to the second Region, and add each resource ARN to the plan as it is created.
Run a scheduled AWS Lambda function that snapshots tagged resources and copies the snapshots to the second Region.
Create an AWS Backup plan with a daily rule in each Region, and assign resources by the tag backup=daily in both.

questions.stem: An AWS Backup rule copies backups to another Region. To reduce cost, the copies must move to cold storage, and the company wants the copies to be deleted as early as the cold storage rules allow. Which pair of settings for the copy is valid and deletes the copy SOONEST, i.e. is the MOST cost-effective valid choice?

choices.text: Transition to cold storage after 30 days, and retention period of 100 days.
Transition to cold storage after 30 days, and retention period of 180 days.
Transition to cold storage after 60 days, and retention period of 120 days.
Transition to cold storage after 90 days, and retention period of 150 days.

questions.stem: To protect against ransomware and insider threats, a company's backups in an AWS Backup vault must never be deleted or altered by any user, including administrators, until their retention period ends. The security team wants a period to test the configuration before it becomes permanent. Which solution BEST meets these requirements?

choices.text: Lock the vault with AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode, with a grace time before the lock becomes immutable.
Lock the vault with AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode, and limit who has the IAM permissions to manage it.
Add an IAM policy that denies backup deletion to every role, and review the policy every month.
Lock the vault with AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode, with no grace time, so that it is immutable immediately.

questions.stem: A company adds an S3 Cross-Region Replication configuration to a bucket that already contains millions of objects. Compliance requires that all existing objects also exist in the destination Region, and that most new objects are replicated within seconds with 99.9 percent of them within 15 minutes, with visibility into replication times. Which actions should the company take? (Choose TWO.)

choices.text: Run an S3 Batch Replication job to replicate the objects that existed before the replication configuration.
Enable S3 Replication Time Control on the replication rule.
Do nothing for existing objects, because live replication copies them automatically after the configuration is added.
Switch to Same-Region Replication, because it replicates existing objects within 15 minutes.
Enable S3 Replication Time Control, which replicates every object within 1 minute.
